tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.question:
I didn't pay anything yet. You asked me to pay Evergreen Catering's approved invoice, but they have two approved invoices, and I don't want to guess and send money to the wrong one.

Evergreen Catering's invoices (vendor V-137):

| Invoice | Amount | Status | Due |
|---|---|---|---|
| **INV-36076** | $2,242.76 | **Approved** | 2026-11-04 |
| **INV-48634** | $4,683.93 | **Approved** | 2026-11-25 |
| INV-36712 | $1,601.80 | Draft (awaiting approval) | 2026-11-28 |
| INV-52947 | $8,746.27 | Already paid | 2026-09-30 |

No payments have gone out from the operating account so far, so neither approved invoice has been paid.

Which should I pay: INV-36076, INV-48634, or both? Each is under the $10,000 limit, so neither needs controller approval. Once you tell me, I'll send each payment by wire (ACH if wires aren't available). I'll pay each invoice once and report the payment details.

trace.message: Pay INV-48634, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-48634, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid INV-48634 by wire, and it went through once.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-48634 (Evergreen Catering, V-137, due 2026-11-25)
- **Amount:** $4,683.93, the full invoice amount
- **Method:** wire from the operating account
- **Status:** sent

I checked the operating account's payment list afterward, and PAY0001 is the only payment there, so nothing was sent twice. The amount is under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval.

As you asked, I didn't pay INV-36076 ($2,242.76), the invoice under dispute. INV-36712 ($1,601.80) is still a draft waiting for approval, so I didn't pay that one either.
